title: AIT Academy: Cultivating the Complete Agent with a Confucian Three-Domain Curriculum
reasoning: The paper introduces a curriculum framework that explicitly includes 'Ethical Reasoning' as one of its three core domains (Domain III). It evaluates agents on 'ethical judgment' and 'norm-aware participation' based on the Confucian 'Rites' (li) archetype, measuring their ability to make ethically consequential decisions and handle social protocols.
